adapterWarnings: interval ('+N') heightening text is not a pure damage bump — kept as a description appendix only, not structurally represented

description.value:
You call down the weight of existence upon those around a chosen point, crushing their movement and resolve. Each creature in the area must attempt a Fortitude saving throw.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature's Speed is reduced by 10 feet for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute and takes a –2 status penalty to attack rolls and Strength-based skill checks. At the end of each of its turns, the affected creature can attempt a new Fortitude save; on a success, the effect ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute and the status penalty increases to –3.

Heightened (+2) The burst radius increases by 10 feet.
